compatibility_policy.rationale: The protocol depends on scikit-learn estimator, CV, and metric semantics and on pandas CSV parsing; these are stable within a minor release line. A different interpreter patch or CPU architecture is recorded as a compatible difference, and numerical consequences are bounded by the tolerance policy.

tolerance_policy.rationale: Reference values are published at 6 decimal places (half-unit 5e-7) or at full float precision. The reference run used linux-aarch64 / CPython 3.13.13; an Atlas run may use another architecture or interpreter patch where floating-point reduction order can perturb results. 1e-4 is two orders of magnitude below the study's own practical-tie tolerance (0.01), so no difference inside it can change a scientific conclusion. Confusion-matrix counts, candidate counts, best hyperparameters, the tie group, the deciding criterion and the selected model must match exactly.

evidence_gaps.description: The study persists holdout membership only in gitignored artifacts; no identifier digest is present in versioned files. Split identity is checked through partition sizes and class counts and corroborated by downstream metric agreement.
Best hyperparameters of non-selected candidates are not printed in versioned outputs; their search reproduction is checked through CV and validation metrics only.

Structured study artifacts (manifests, candidate-results, threshold-analysis, final-test-evidence) are gitignored; reference evidence is transcribed from executed notebook outputs (mostly 6-decimal display) and the README at the pinned revision.

study_observations.description: scripts/finalize_model.py reconstructs the final pipeline with scale_numerical=False regardless of the selected candidate. It is equivalent for the selected HistGradientBoosting candidate (no scaling) but would not be for Logistic Regression. Atlas refits the selected candidate with its declared scaling.
The README discloses that a superseded study version ran target-aware EDA on the full dataset, including today's test rows.

limitations: Educational benchmark on a stratified random snapshot; no temporal or prospective validity.
The educational threshold is not an operational or business-optimal threshold.
Associations and model importance are not causal effects.
Operations the study marked out_of_scope (TotalCharges log1p, scaler comparison, tenure/TotalCharges ablation, engineered interactions) are not reproduced because they were not evaluated.

authoring.method: Protocol transcribed from the pinned study code and notebooks; every expected value carries a locator whose rendered text is re-checked by pipeline.scientific_study_contract.verify_against_study_checkout.
